content: En Depit eh Wiewia kan en Powehdi
Ahnsou ehu mwuri, Nanmwarki Depit pwurehng mahweniong mehn Pilisdia kan oh kaloweiraildi oh ketikihsang irail manaman en kakaun sahpwo.

E ahpw pil kalowehdi mehn Mohap kan. E kaunediong me lohdi kan nanpwel e ahpw kin kemehla riemen sang ni irek en silimen koaros. Eri, mehn Mohap ahpw wiahla sapwellime aramas oh irail kin pwainohng daksis.
Mwuhr e ahpw pil kalowehdi nanmwarkien Sopa nan Siria, Adadeser nein Rehop, nindokon Adadeser eh ketket kolahng onesapahl sapwellime manaman pohn sahpw ni palipowehn Pillap Iupreitis.
Depit kalowehdi soundak oahs kid isipwiki oh sounpei alu rianen. E koledi uwen oahs me itarohng wa werennansapw epwiki a e kauwehla nehn oahs teikan koaros.
Ahnsou me mehn Siria sang Damaskus kadarala karis ehu mehn sewese Nanmwarki Adadeser, Depit ahpw mahweniong kariso oh kemehla sounpei rianen riekid.
Mwuhr e ahpw kauwada impwal en sounpei kei nan sapwarailo, re ahpw wiahla sapwellime aramas oh kin pwainohng daksis. KAUN-O ketin kupwurehla Depit pwe en powehdi wasa koaros.
Depit kalowehdi mehn sansar kohl me sapwellimen Adadeser lapalap akan kin weuwa oh walahng nan Serusalem.
E pil ketiki kohla uwe ehu en prons sang Peda oh Perodai, kahnimw kei me Adadeser kaunda.
Toi, nanmwarkien Amad karongehda me Depit kalowehdi karis koaros en Nanmwarki Adadeser.

Ih eri kadarala sapwellime pwutak Soram rehn Depit pwehn rahnmwahwih oh kapingahki eh powehdi Nanmwarki Adadeser, me pak tohto kin mahweniong Toi. Soram kadarala rehn Depit kisakis kei me wiawihkihda kohl, silper, oh prons.
Nanmwarki Depit eri kasarawihong kisakis pwukat ong mehn doadoahk ni kaudok, iangahki kohl oh silper kan me lohdi sang wehi kan me e kalowehdi—
Edom, Mohap, Ammon, Pilisdia, oh Amalek—pil iangahki dipwisou kei me lohdi sang rehn Adadeser.
Depit eri ndandla mehlel ni ahnsou me e pwurasang wasa me e kemehla ie mehn Edom nen welikid nan Wahun Soahl.
E ahpw kauwada impwalen sounpei kei nan Edom, oh aramas en wasao ahpw wiahla sapwellime. KAUN-O ketin kupwurehla Depit pwehn kalowehdi wasa koaros.
Depit kaunda Israel pwon oh ketin koasoanehdi pwe aramas koaros en sapwellime wehi en kin ale wahu oh pwuhng ahnsou koaros.
Sohap me eh nohno Seruaia, iei ih me kaunen karis; Seosopat nein Ahilud me wia kaunen palien pwuhk;
Sadok nein Ahidup oh Ahimelek nein Apaiadar me wia samworo; Seraia me sounnting en nan tehnpaso;
Penaia nein Sehoiada me kaunen silepen Depit; oh nein Depit pwutak ko me samworo.
